status: reviewed by the maintainer on 4 November 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Child's Rights Act 2003 (as enacted). Each query names the one section that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against this release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday and legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 4 November 2026.

queries.query: Must the best interest of the child come first in every decision about a child?
queries.note: s.1 best interest is the primary consideration.

queries.query: Does every child have a right to a name and to have their birth registered?
queries.note: s.5(1) name; s.5(2) birth registration.

queries.query: Can anyone read a child's letters or listen to their phone calls?
queries.note: s.8 privacy of correspondence and telephone conversations.

queries.query: Can a child be treated differently because they were born outside marriage?
queries.note: s.10(2) no disability by reason of circumstances of birth.

queries.query: Can a child be separated from their parents against the child's wish?
queries.note: s.14(1) right to parental care; limited exceptions.

queries.query: Is basic education free and compulsory for children in Nigeria?
queries.note: s.15(1) free, compulsory and universal basic education.

queries.query: Can a child sue for injuries suffered before birth?
queries.note: s.17(1) action for harm before, during or after birth.

queries.query: What responsibilities does a child have towards family and society?
queries.note: s.19 responsibilities of a child.

queries.query: What is the minimum age for marriage under the Child's Rights Act?
queries.note: s.21 under 18 cannot contract a valid marriage.

queries.query: Can parents promise their daughter in marriage while she is still a child?
queries.note: s.22 child betrothal prohibited and void.

queries.query: What is the punishment for marrying a child?
queries.note: s.23 fine of N500,000 or five years' imprisonment or both.

queries.query: Is it an offence to give a child tribal marks or a tattoo?
queries.note: s.24 tattoos and skin marks.

queries.query: What happens to someone who uses a child to sell or traffic drugs?
queries.note: s.25 narcotic drugs.

queries.query: Is it an offence to take a child away from their parents without consent?
queries.note: s.27 removal from lawful custody.

queries.query: Can a child be made to work, and what work is allowed?
queries.note: s.28 exploitative labour; light family work allowed.

queries.query: Is it illegal to use children for street hawking or begging?
queries.note: s.30 dealing in children, begging, hawking.

queries.query: What is the punishment for having sex with a child?
queries.note: s.31 rape, imprisonment for life.

queries.query: Can children be recruited into the Nigerian army?
queries.note: s.34 no recruitment into the armed forces.

queries.query: How can a child in danger be removed quickly by court order?
queries.note: s.42 emergency protection orders.

queries.query: Can the police take a child into protection in an emergency?
queries.note: s.44 police protection.

queries.query: Can a court order a parent to contribute to the upkeep of a child placed in care?
queries.note: s.52 contribution to maintenance.

queries.query: Can a court order a DNA test to prove who a child's father is?
queries.note: s.63 scientific tests including DNA.

queries.query: Who gets custody of a child when parents separate?
queries.note: s.69 custody and access orders.

queries.query: Can a foster parent marry the child they are fostering?
queries.note: s.118 prohibited; up to fourteen years.

queries.query: Who is allowed to adopt a child in Nigeria?
queries.note: s.129 persons who may adopt.

queries.query: Whose consent is needed before a child can be adopted?
queries.note: s.132 required consent.

queries.query: Is it legal to pay money to adopt a child?
queries.note: s.143 payments for adoption prohibited without court sanction.

queries.query: Which court hears cases about children?
queries.note: s.149 Family Court.

queries.query: Can newspapers publish the name or photo of a child in a court case?
queries.note: s.157 identification of child prohibited.

queries.query: Do day care centres and child minders need to be registered?
queries.note: s.163 register of child minders and day care.

queries.query: Must a children's home be registered before it can care for children?
queries.note: s.195 registration of children's homes.

queries.query: Can a child be kept in detention while waiting for trial?
queries.note: s.212 detention as last resort.

queries.query: Can a child offender be sentenced to death or imprisonment?
queries.note: s.221 no imprisonment, corporal punishment or death penalty.

queries.query: Who is a child under the Child's Rights Act?
queries.note: s.277 child means a person under eighteen.
